claim: Roads are made for movement, not staying

text.text: Roads are made for movement, not staying
Frontage condition, and people staying (upper number) and moving (lower number) at each gate.
text.label: Figure

text.text: Across six gates we counted 1,906 people. Only 502 of them stopped; the other 1,404 were passing through. The two eastern gates hold two thirds of everyone who stayed.

The idea holds in part. The frontage is mixed all the way round, yet the street works against it: a 21 m carriageway with six lanes and more than 100 parked vehicles leaves people a 3 m pavement on each side.
Street section: a 21 m carriageway with six lanes, and a 3 m sidewalk each side.
